tool_schemas.name: execute_query
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL against the specified Snowflake workspace using the caller’s API key, records a query-run ledger entry (status, timings, errors, and result metadata), and returns the run details plus results according to result_format (inline_json returns up to max_rows rows inline, chunked returns a reference to stored result chunks, none returns no row data). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id format is invalid, sql is empty, unknown fields are provided, or max_rows/max_runtime_ms are < 1; raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing/invalid and FORBIDDEN if the key is not permitted to use the workspace. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds the API key’s row/runtime/cost limits, NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id does not exist, and EXECUTION_ERROR when Snowflake rejects the statement or the runtime limit is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (Snowflake connection profile) to execute the SQL against.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller for authentication and quota enforcement.

sql.description: SQL text to execute on Snowflake.

parameters.description: Named bind parameters for the SQL statement (key/value pairs).

result_format.description: How to return results: inline JSON, chunked via stored chunks, or none for non-result statements.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (also constrained by the API key policy).

max_runtime_ms.description: Maximum allowed runtime in milliseconds (also constrained by the API key policy).

request_context.description: Arbitrary request metadata persisted with the query run for auditing (e.g., caller, trace id).

tool_schemas.name: list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists Snowflake workspaces (connection profiles) visible to the caller, with optional filtering by status. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses requests with invalid pagination parameters.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and authorize access to workspaces.

name_prefix.description: Filter workspaces whose name starts with this prefix (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous list_workspaces response.

tool_schemas.name: create_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Snowflake workspace (connection profile) and returns the created workspace. The workspace is created in status='active' unless explicitly set to 'suspended'. Refuses invalid Snowflake connection fields or unsupported auth_method.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and authorize workspace creation.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status (deleted is not allowed on create).

snowflake_account.description: Snowflake account identifier (as used in the Snowflake connection URL).

default_warehouse.description: Default warehouse to use when executing queries.

default_database.description: Default database to use when executing queries.

default_schema.description: Default schema to use when executing queries.

auth_method.description: Authentication method used to connect to Snowflake.

auth_secret_ref.description: Reference to stored secret material (e.g., password, private key, OAuth refresh token). Secret value is never returned.

network_policy.description: Optional network policy identifier/name to apply to Snowflake sessions for this workspace.

tool_schemas.name: update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates fields on an existing workspace and/or performs allowed lifecycle transitions via status. Returns the updated workspace. Refuses transitions not permitted by the workspace lifecycle (active<->suspended, active|suspended->deleted) and refuses updates to deleted workspaces except no-op reads.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and authorize workspace updates.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Only allowed transitions are enforced.

auth_secret_ref.description: Updated reference to stored secret material. Secret value is never returned.

tool_schemas.name: create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for a workspace and returns the API key record plus the one-time plaintext key. The returned plaintext key is shown only once and is never retrievable again. Refuses creation for suspended/deleted workspaces.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and authorize API key management.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to create the API key under.

name.description: Human-readable name/label for the API key.

allowed_sql_types.description: Allowed SQL statement types for this key. The service classifies each submitted statement and enforces membership.

max_rows.description: Maximum rows that may be returned for queries executed by this key.

max_runtime_ms.description: Maximum runtime allowed for queries executed by this key, in milliseconds.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Maximum number of execute_query calls per minute for this key.

monthly_query_limit.description: Optional maximum number of query runs per calendar month for this key.

monthly_credits_limit.description: Optional maximum Snowflake credits attributable to this key per calendar month.

tool_schemas.name: update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API key’s metadata/policy and/or performs allowed lifecycle transitions via status (active->revoked). Returns the updated API key record. Refuses any attempt to reactivate a revoked key or to set invalid policy values.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the caller and authorize API key management.

name.description: Updated human-readable name/label for the API key.

status.description: Lifecycle status. Only active->revoked is permitted.

allowed_sql_types.description: Updated allowed SQL statement types for this key.

max_runtime_ms.description: Updated maximum runtime cap in milliseconds.

monthly_query_limit.description: Updated optional monthly query limit. Omit to keep unchanged; set to null to clear (if supported by the backend).

monthly_credits_limit.description: Updated optional monthly credits limit. Omit to keep unchanged; set to null to clear (if supported by the backend).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided API key, including key status, effective scopes/policies, and current quota/rate-limit consumption snapshots. Refuses revoked or unknown keys.

api_key.description: API key presented by the caller.
